## 说明

该函数针对总渔获量以及主要物种、国家或渔区，找出峰值渔获量出现的年份和数值、最后一年渔获量占峰值的百分比，以及最近`recent_years`年的趋势：年均增长率，以及Mann-Kendall趋势检验（年份与渔获量之间的Kendall τ）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function finds, for the total catch and for the main species, countries or fishing areas,
the year and size of the peak catch, the catch in the last year as a percentage of the peak,
and the trend over the last `recent_years` years: the average annual growth rate, and a
Mann-Kendall trend test (Kendall's tau between year and catch).

</details>

## 用法

```r
peak_trend(
  area_data,
  by = c("species", "country", "area"),
  top_n = 10,
  recent_years = 10,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  plot_show = fao_setting("plot_show"),
  label = NULL
)
```

## 参数

`area_data`
:   FAO渔获数据：`fishing_area_data()$area_data`，或`load_fao_data()`的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    FAO catch data: `fishing_area_data()$area_data`, or any subset of
    `load_fao_data()` (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).

    </details>

`by`
:   比较的对象："species"（物种，默认）、"country"（国家）或"area"（渔区）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    What to compare: "species" (default), "country" or "area".

    </details>

`top_n`
:   纳入总渔获量最大的物种、国家或渔区的个数。默认为10；用`Inf`表示全部。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The number of species, countries or areas with the largest total catch to include.
    Default is 10; use `Inf` for all.

    </details>

`recent_years`

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or

    </details>

`pptx`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in

:   逻辑值。为TRUE时，每张图在保存的同时也画在绘图窗口中（例如RStudio的Plots窗格），便于立即查看。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(plot_show = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。无论是否显示，图表都会保存为文件（`plot = TRUE`）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, each chart is also drawn in the plot window (e.g.

`label`
:   输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个序列一行（第一行为总渔获量）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per series (the first row is the total).

</details>

## 详细说明

渔获量序列存在自相关，会使常规的Mann-Kendall检验发现过多的趋势，因此用AR(1)过程的有效样本量校正检验的方差（Yue和Wang，2004）；所用的自相关是去趋势序列的滞后1期自相关，并校正了其小样本偏差（Kendall，1954；`lag1_autocorrelation`）。`p_value_iid`是常规检验的p值，供比较。只有十年数据时，自相关难以估计准确，校正也只是部分的：自相关很强的序列仍然会过于频繁地显示出趋势。`trend`对每条序列单独检验（`p_value` < 0.05）：序列很多时，有些趋势是偶然发现的，`q_value`给出按结果中的序列数（总量除外）校正后的p值（Benjamini和Hochberg，1995）。应把`p_value` < 0.05的趋势视为探索性结果，把`q_value` < 0.05的趋势作为显著趋势报告，`fao_report()`对主要物种和国家就是这样做的。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Catch series are autocorrelated, which makes the usual Mann-Kendall test find too many trends,
so the variance of the test is corrected with the effective sample size of an AR(1) process
(Yue and Wang 2004), from the lag-1 autocorrelation of the detrended series corrected for its
small-sample bias (Kendall 1954; `lag1_autocorrelation`); `p_value_iid` is the p value of the
usual test, for comparison. Over ten years the autocorrelation is poorly known and the
correction is only partial: strongly autocorrelated series still show trends too often. `trend` tests each series on its own
(`p_value` < 0.05): with many series, some trends are found by chance, and `q_value` gives the
p values adjusted for the number of series in the result, the total excepted (Benjamini and
Hochberg 1995). Read trends with `p_value` < 0.05 as exploratory, and give as significant
the trends with `q_value` < 0.05, as `fao_report()` does for the main species and countries.

</details>

## 参考文献

Benjamini, Y. and Hochberg, Y. (1995). Controlling the false discovery rate: a practical and
powerful approach to multiple testing. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B 57:
289-300. [doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x)

Kendall, M.G. (1954). Note on bias in the estimation of autocorrelation. Biometrika 41: 403-404.
[doi:10.1093/biomet/41.3-4.403](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/41.3-4.403)

Yue, S. and Wang, C.Y. (2004). The Mann-Kendall test modified by effective sample size to
detect trend in serially correlated hydrological series. Water Resources Management 18:
201-218. [doi:10.1023/B:WARM.0000043140.61082.60](https://doi.org/10.1023/B:WARM.0000043140.61082.60)

## 示例

```r
FAO27 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Northeast", plot = FALSE)
peak_trend(FAO27$area_data, by = "species", lang = "zh")
peak_trend(FAO27$area_data, by = "country", lang = "zh")
```
